text:
About 2.23% of the property (81.3 ha of 3,643.5 ha) was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021, according to Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change. The evidence supports this finding. A later year (up to 2025) was observed, and the JRC 2020 forest map agrees on 98% of the affected area.

Context: about 68.1 ha of the loss was in planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was in native forest. Separately, 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.

Limits: this shows tree-cover loss, not deforestation or land-use change, since Hansen's measure includes plantation harvest. It does not establish the cause, legality, or responsible party, and it is not a compliance finding.
